main.description: Per-sample data recorded during an activity, for charts. Its rkey is its activity's. Public streams are a record in the athlete's repo; followers, mutuals or self streams are a record in the athlete's app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for that tier. Never more visible than its activity. The AppView serves it only to the viewers its tier allows.

activity.description: The activity's URI; it shares this record's rkey.

visibility.description: Who may see the streams: anyone, the athlete's effective followers, the athlete's mutuals, or only the athlete.

channels.description: The channels #streamData holds, so a client knows which charts exist without fetching it.

zoneSnapshot.description: The athlete's zones when the activity was published, so later threshold changes don't change its time in zone.

model.description: The zone model token, e.g. cogganPower6.

lows.description: Each zone's lower bound in bpm or watts, lowest zone first; each zone ends where the next begins.

streamData.description: The data blob's JSON. Every array lines up with time; a channel the activity lacks is absent, and a missing sample is null (blob contents aren't validated against lexicons). No positions: the activity's track holds those.

gearChange.description: A shift by electronic shifting, with the gears it shifted to as the derailleurs number them (rear gear 1 is the largest cog).
